notes: AbbVie paid $8.7B for Cerevel's lead asset emraclidine — a selective M4 muscarinic agonist for schizophrenia. Phase 2 data was the basis at deal time. CRITICAL CONTEXT: emraclidine failed both EMPOWER Phase 2 readouts in November 2024 (post-deal close). The deal value reflects the consensus PRE-FAILURE assessment. Including in the cohort because the deal was real and the framework should reflect what acquirers actually pay for Phase 2 CNS small molecules — including ones that subsequently fail. The peak sales estimate of $3B is the pre-failure consensus; post-failure realistic peak is near zero.
selection_rationale: Recent (2023-2024), single-asset, CNS-small-molecule M&A. Including the post-deal failure provides important calibration: M&A premia on Phase 2 CNS assets reflect risk that sometimes resolves negatively. This is the framework working as intended.
source: AbbVie press release Dec 6 2023; Cerevel SEC filings; AbbVie Q4 2024 earnings transcript (emraclidine failure disclosure).
